decisions.reason: The indoor air quality sensor module fits the firm’s established sensing-and-firmware platform, so its close knowledge overlap gives us good ability to refine it and learn from early customer use.
The voltage measurement module is a direct next-generation replacement of an existing product, which signals strong related know-how, low integration risk, and clear scope for iterative improvement.

The MQTT software proxy builds directly on our software bindings and connectivity capabilities, making it highly compatible with our existing knowledge base and valuable for the wider modular ecosystem.
The CAN bus interface module closely matches our core competence in modular communication hardware for automation and embedded use, so we are well positioned to support and improve it.

The carbon dioxide sensor module extends our sensor portfolio in a way that is technologically adjacent to our existing electronics and API strengths, allowing effective learning and commercial application.

The touch panel accessory complements the platform and can be supported with our established hardware, firmware, and documentation processes, so it is worth retaining while usage feedback accumulates.
